name: Builder
overview: The biblical concept of the 'Builder' is richly illustrated through the metaphor of the cornerstone, which the builders rejected but God appointed as the chief foundation stone, as seen in Psalms 118:22, Matthew 21:42, and Acts 4:11. This cornerstone symbolizes Jesus Christ, whose rejection by human builders contrasts with His divine role as the essential foundation of God's redemptive work. Hebrews 11:10 further expands this imagery by affirming God as the ultimate builder and maker of the eternal city, highlighting His sovereign authority and creative power in establishing a firm and lasting foundation for His people.
